% Blue Accent CV - adapted for the Job Tracker CV Builder.
% Source: the Word-mirroring LaTeX resume.
%
% Placeholders available: {{fullName}} {{headline}} {{email}} {{phone}}
%                        {{links}} {{experience}} {{education}} {{profile}} {{certificates}} {{skills}}
%
% What was changed and why:
%   1. \input{glyphtounicode} and \pdfgentounicode removed. That file is not
%      shipped by any Debian TeX Live package, and \input is a blocked primitive
%      (it would let a template read any file in the sandbox). It only affects
%      text copy-paste out of the PDF, nothing visual.
%   2. \usepackage[usenames,dvipsnames]{color} removed. xcolor on the next line
%      already defines \definecolor with HTML support, and the plain `color`
%      package is not on the allowlist.
%   3. All personal data replaced with placeholders, and every multi-line field
%      wrapped in \obeylines so one line per entry in the form becomes one line
%      on the CV. Without \obeylines a newline is just a space to LaTeX and the
%      whole field collapses into a single run-on bullet.
%   4. A placeholder swallows both brace pairs, so it keeps a space when it sits
%      inside another group: \resumeItem{ {{experience}} }.
%
% Placeholders inside this comment are ignored - TeX discards comments, so it is
% safe to document them here.
%
% Sections that still need a placeholder before they can be filled from the
% form: Resume summary, Projects, Languages. The macros they would use are kept
% below so they are ready to drop in.

\documentclass[letterpaper]{article}
\usepackage[utf8]{inputenc}
\usepackage[T1]{fontenc}
\usepackage{latexsym}
\usepackage[empty]{fullpage}
\usepackage{titlesec}
\usepackage{marvosym}
\usepackage{xcolor}
\usepackage{enumitem}
\usepackage[colorlinks=true]{hyperref}
\usepackage{fancyhdr}
\usepackage{tabularx}

% Blue accent matching the Word version (#2563EB)
\definecolor{accent}{HTML}{2563EB}
\definecolor{navy}{HTML}{1F2937}
\definecolor{greytext}{HTML}{555555}

\hypersetup{
  linkcolor=accent,
  urlcolor=accent,
  citecolor=accent,
}

\pagestyle{fancy}
\fancyhf{}
\renewcommand{\headrulewidth}{0pt}
\renewcommand{\footrulewidth}{0pt}

% Margins
\addtolength{\oddsidemargin}{-0.55in}
\addtolength{\evensidemargin}{-0.55in}
\addtolength{\textwidth}{1.1in}
\addtolength{\topmargin}{-0.6in}
\addtolength{\textheight}{1.3in}

\urlstyle{same}
\raggedright
\raggedbottom
\setlength{\tabcolsep}{0in}

% Section titles - blue, matching Word headers
\titleformat{\section}{
  \vspace{-1pt}\color{accent}\scshape\raggedright\large
}{}{0em}{}[\color{accent}\titlerule \vspace{-1pt}]
\titlespacing*{\section}{0pt}{6pt}{4pt}

% Custom commands
\newcommand{\resumeItem}[1]{\item\small{{#1}}}
\newcommand{\resumeSubheading}[4]{
  \vspace{-1pt}\item
  \begin{tabular*}{0.97\textwidth}[t]{l@{\extracolsep{\fill}}r}
    \textbf{#1} & \textit{\color{greytext}#2} \\
    \textit{\small\color{greytext} #3} & \textit{\small\color{greytext} #4}
  \end{tabular*}\vspace{-2pt}
}
\newcommand{\resumeProjectHeading}[2]{
  \item
  \begin{tabular*}{0.97\textwidth}{l@{\extracolsep{\fill}}r}
    \small #1 & #2
  \end{tabular*}\vspace{-1pt}
}

\newcommand{\resumeSubHeadingListStart}{\begin{itemize}[leftmargin=0.18in, label={}, itemsep=1.2pt, topsep=2.5pt, parsep=0pt]}
\newcommand{\resumeSubHeadingListEnd}{\end{itemize}\vspace{-2pt}}

\newcommand{\resumeItemListStart}{\begin{itemize}[leftmargin=0.24in, label={}, itemsep=0.9pt, topsep=1.2pt, parsep=0pt]}
\newcommand{\resumeItemListEnd}{\end{itemize}\vspace{-2pt}}

\newcommand{\resumeProjectListStart}{\begin{itemize}[leftmargin=0.24in, label={}, itemsep=0.9pt, topsep=1.2pt, parsep=0pt]}
\newcommand{\resumeProjectListEnd}{\end{itemize}\vspace{-2pt}}

\newcommand{\resumeLangHeading}[2]{
  \vspace{-1pt}\item
  \begin{tabular*}{0.97\textwidth}[t]{l@{\extracolsep{\fill}}r}
    \textbf{#1} & #2
  \end{tabular*}\vspace{-1pt}
}

\begin{document}

% ---------- HEADER ----------
\begin{center}
    \textbf{\Huge \scshape \color{navy} {{fullName}}} \\[3pt]
    \small \textbf{\color{accent} {{headline}}} \\[3pt]
    \footnotesize \color{greytext}
    {{phone}} $\quad|\quad$
    \href{mailto:{{email}}}{\underline{ {{email}} }} $\quad|\quad$
    {{links}}
\end{center}
\vspace{4pt}

% ---------- PROFILE ----------
\section{Profile}
{\obeylines
\resumeSubHeadingListStart
  \resumeItem{ {{profile}} }
\resumeSubHeadingListEnd
}
\vspace{-2pt}

% ---------- EXPERIENCE ----------
% One line per role in the Experience field: "Role, Company (dates)".
\section{Experience}
{\obeylines
\resumeSubHeadingListStart
  \resumeItem{ {{experience}} }
\resumeSubHeadingListEnd
}

% ---------- TECHNICAL SKILLS ----------
% One line per skill group: "Category: item, item, item".
\section{Technical Skills}
{\obeylines
\begin{itemize}[leftmargin=0.18in, label={}, topsep=2pt, itemsep=1pt, parsep=0pt]
\footnotesize{
  \item {{skills}}
}
\end{itemize}
}

% ---------- EDUCATION ----------
% One line per qualification: "Degree, School (dates)".
\section{Education}
{\obeylines
\resumeSubHeadingListStart
  \resumeItem{ {{education}} }
\resumeSubHeadingListEnd
}

% ---------- CERTIFICATES ----------
% One line per certificate: "Cert Name, Issuer (year)".
\section{Certificates}
{\obeylines
\resumeSubHeadingListStart
  \resumeItem{ {{certificates}} }
\resumeSubHeadingListEnd
}

\end{document}
